s00272.summary: Barnaby counts swans in the boathouse while Odalys climbs out of one.
Odalys and Barnaby bicker over whether there are eleven or twelve swans.
Pete dangles overhead, drops the flashlight, and all three squabble about swan names.
Barnaby quietly admits the twelfth swan exists, drops his clipboard, and a distant swan turns its head.

s01720.summary: Four people gather at the drained pool's rim under a humming work light.
They argue about the boy who died while knocking sounds rise from under the tile.
The light dies, laughter echoes, and everyone panics and scrambles.
The light returns and wet footprints walk toward them across the deep end.

s00284.summary: Humphrey and Prizzy wait in an empty ballroom for a presenter who never arrives.
Humphrey complains about the absence and jokes that the cockroach looks Greek.
Prizzy volunteers to present, walks to the front, and starts the deck.
The door bangs with no one there; Prizzy carries on kindly and Humphrey quips.

s00205.summary: Coach times Darius in an abandoned rink as a radio reports a loss.
Coach tells Darius his glove side is a screen door; Darius bristles.
Rookie Len arrives early and nervous, and Coach needles him about sleep.
Coach orders Len to shoot on Darius, who blocks and mutters at him.
Len and Darius say 'again' together, then face each other as Coach smiles.

s00163.summary: Six people share a late supper at the baker's table, including a hooded stranger.
The stranger says he is saving room for the fire.
Silvanus unhoods, says he serves the Lord Mayor, and warns the oven is dangerous.
Hobb douses the hearth and steam fills the room as everyone coughs.
Silvanus sadly says it is too late as a bell rings outside.

s02324.summary: A family gathers in the cod-drying shed with Grandpa mending nets.
Elinborg confronts her father about reopening the shed and her plan to sell.
Elinborg presents the developer's offer; Óskar bristles about his family's legacy.
Kari admits the shed's smell reminds him of his grandfather.
Sigrún reveals the offer figure she read in her mother's folder.
Óskar has Kari smell a fish and admits he cannot say what it is worth.
Elinborg laughs and wipes her eyes, Bjarni hands her coffee, Sigrún keeps counting.

s00490.summary: Tobias works the telegraph key in the flooded office.
Sheriff Billie wades in dragging chained prisoner Kittredge and chains him to the wall.
The judge orders the prisoner held; Billie tells him he can come get him.
Kittredge needles Billie, who answers coldly and stares him down about the rising water.
Tobias finds damp matches and Billie lights the stove, bringing warmth.
The judge replies 'Understood' and Billie almost smiles as the wagon drifts away.

s01840.summary: Rico bowls alone against a blank name on the scoreboard.
A girl named Daisy appears and the scoreboard rearranges to spell her name.
Daisy says her dead father Manny wrote that Rico moved the pin.
Rico admits he cheated at twenty-two and only scored two seventy-one.
Rico teaches Daisy to throw and smiles as she knocks down pins.

s00512.summary: A stagecoach sinks mid-river with Amos on the box and the Tates inside.
Water seeps in as Leonora steadies her son and Amos gives instructions.
The coach lurches and Amos hauls Leonora and Lijah onto the roof.
Lijah loses his hat and Leonora shows the christening gown, giving it to Lijah.
The horses pull the coach toward the bank.

s00797.summary: The underwater hockey team waits on the pool deck under Coach Beverly.
Beverly poses a last-second play and Ruslan and Dewayne snipe at each other.
Pham whistles positions and the players slip silently into the pool.

s01990.summary: Octavia preps witness Samuel in a windowless room before tomorrow's testimony.
Octavia pushes Samuel to call the ledger discrepancies accounting error.
Samuel asks what happens if he tells the truth and pushes the folder back.
Octavia offers a truthful statement and Samuel pockets it.

s01723.summary: Philippa questions operator Agnes in the wireless room during an emergency.
Agnes hides her message while Philippa demands to see it.
The captain orders Agnes through the tube to send the message as written.
Philippa reads the message, turns white, and tells Agnes to send it.

s01309.summary: Nadine repairs a phone while bored shop owner Elijah scrolls.
A batteryless phone rings and a pale finger curls from its hole.
Nadine hurls the phone, smashing it, and the ringing stops.
They stare at the wreckage as a green LED blinks in the debris.

s02407.summary: A stalled bus idles in fog with Mabel and three children.
Oswin spots something in the road and a tall figure appears in the beam.
The figure approaches and taps the windshield; Mabel kills the headlights.

s00400.summary: The crew counts cryo-pods in the cargo hold and gets conflicting totals.
Astrid finds a pod's glass bowed outward, suggesting someone woke inside the ship.
Bashir notes the hatch tape is peeled from inside; Tomasz orders it opened.
Someone behind the hatch knocks politely.

s01983.summary: Gus rehearses his tour spiel to empty seats while Ferdy critiques.
Gus accuses Ferdy of rewriting his card and they argue about the company.
Ferdy lunges for the microphone and trips; Gus looms furious.
Ferdy admits he hit the carousel and Gus confesses he mistook the pony for real.
The two men dissolve into laughter and make peace.
Gus takes the microphone and resumes the tour, muttering the old date.

s02336.summary: Director Volkov enters the break room and confronts the intern Cassandra.
Volkov says she has seen Cassandra do nothing; Cassandra says she is shadowing her.
Volkov promotes Cassandra for noticing and leaves; Cassandra follows.

s01881.summary: Staff and a visitor share breakfast in the observatory while a stranger waits at the door.
The stranger is introduced as relief mechanic Pryce and takes a seat.
Okonkwo-Reyes notes Pryce appears on no manifest.
Pryce reveals he is the chairman and accuses the crew of lying to Earth.
Lindqvist has Pryce look up at a ring of pulsing lights, the reason they stopped reporting.

s02460.summary: Goblin accountant Gorlan demands eleven sheep from farmer Phineas as tithe.
The dragon rumbles from offstage, discouraging negotiation.
Phineas chooses a weekly pie over sheep, delighting the dragon.

s00290.summary: Soldiers hold a flooded crypt command post while shells fall.
The colonel orders them to hold until dawn despite shelling.
Shells hit and Winifred and Lucian plan a fallback through the ossuary.
Reuben spots movement on the stairs and everyone raises rifles at an open hand.
The barrage ends and Winifred orders everyone to rest until dawn.

s01551.summary: Chidinma and the team fight to stabilize a bleeding seventeen-year-old stab victim.
Chidinma has Tobias place the chest tube and the patient's pressure recovers.
They send the patient to the OR and Chidinma praises Tobias.

s01006.summary: A courtroom on a ferry convenes with an empty gallery.
The judge mangles Timothy's name and the state calls the defendant's mother.
The ferry lurches and rival counsel share a smile before adjourning until docking.

s00673.summary: A girl and old Ignacio wait on a night ferry deck as the crossing drags on.
Ignacio makes the girl say her full name Wren to say at the dock.
Wren asks if Ignacio will be there and he puts his hat on her head.

s02392.summary: Callie packs her late father's tackle shop slowly, avoiding the answering machine.
Callie plays the recorded greeting and touches the machine like a sleeping animal.
Callie boxes the phone, takes the stuffed pike, and turns off the light.

s02190.summary: A family gathers at a lighthouse table set with an empty fifth chair.
Nell asks Rafe what he found on the rocks and he deflects.
Patterson sets a bowl at the empty place and the family silently grieves.
